desc: Implement the Maximum Spanning Tree construction for the grid graph using a priority queue (Prim's algorithm).
Implement the LCA preprocessing (binary lifting) on the resulting tree to support range minimum queries on paths.
Implement the query logic to calculate the bottleneck height and derive the final answer based on $Y$ and $Z$.
Handle input/output efficiently and ensure 1-based indexing conversion.
Run the code against the provided sample input to verify output.
Test edge cases: $H=1, W=1$ (though constraints say distinct start/end), $Y=Z$, max heights.
Ensure no recursion limit issues (using iterative BFS/LCA).
Confirm time complexity on max constraints ($500 \times 500$ grid, $2 \cdot 10^5$ queries).
